idea-plugin.name: JWT Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Decode and verify JSON Web Tokens directly in the IDE. A dedicated tool window decodes the header and payload (Base64URL, not standard Base64) into two independently scrollable panels — no fixed-height table that becomes unusable once a token has more than a couple of claims.

Signature verification for the twelve JWS algorithms the JDK implements — HS256/HS384/HS512, RS256/RS384/RS512, PS256/PS384/PS512 and ES256/ES384/ES512 — using only javax.crypto/java.security, with no bundled crypto library. Paste the shared secret for HMAC or a public key/certificate PEM for the rest: the token's own alg header decides which one is used. An unsigned token (alg: none) is reported as unsigned rather than as an unsupported algorithm.

iat/exp/nbf claims are rendered as human-readable dates with a clear expired/expiring-soon/valid indicator.

Nothing typed into the tool window is ever saved or cached between sessions — the token, secret, and key are held in memory only.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.
